title: Best Thanksgiving Football Cards: Most Valuable Cards for Sanders, Smith, Mahomes & Allen
summary: From Barry Sanders and Emmitt Smith grails to Mahomes vs. Allen rookie records, explore the best Thanksgiving football cards and new Courtyard pack drops.
body_markdown:
[Barry Sanders](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Barry%20Sanders&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and[Emmitt Smith](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Emmitt%20Smith&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) are the top two rushers in[NFL](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) Thanksgiving Day history. That’s a one-two punch worthy of a[turducken](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/t3HpJgC9p6w) .


This year, a heavyweight matchup between two of the game’s best quarterbacks,[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , headlines a jam-packed day of football—and Courtyard is launching a lineup of[football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) tied to the games that’s got all the excitement of a proper Thanksgiving meal.


While gridiron legends are made on Sundays (and Mondays…and Thursdays…[and Wednesday’s too](https://www.reddit.com/r/nfl/comments/1s3q14x/every_nfl_game_played_on_a_wednesday_since_1950/) ), Thanksgiving Day football has a magical way of bringing out the best in players, and we’re excited to see what the Packers and Rams can cook up during the Thanksgiving appetizers, and what the Bears, Lions, Eagles, Cowboys, Chiefs, and Bills can bring to the table this Turkey Day.


Ahead of the annual feast, Courtyard takes a look at the NFL’s Thanksgiving Day history, iconic grails from Barry Sanders and Emmitt Smith, and the record-setting cards from two of the modern game’s most exploding—and expensive—players: Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen.


As Thanksgiving Day great John Madden always said,[“The team with the most points at the end of the game has the best chance of winning."](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gqgBenCQdvg)


## **NFL Thanksgiving Football History**


The Detroit Lions hosted their first Thanksgiving game in 1934. The Dallas Cowboys became a host in 1966, and the NFL added a third game in 2006.


It’s hard to imagine Thanksgiving without the Lions or Cowboys, and while both squads have fielded some undercooked meals over the years, this year promises to be a high-flying affair for both teams thanks to superstars like[CeeDee Lamb](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Ceedee%20Lamb&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Amon-Ra St. Brown](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Amon-Ra%20St.%20Brown&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Jahmyr Gibbs](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jahmyr%20Gibbs&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , and both teams’ star-studded offenses.


This year, the slate has grown from the traditional three-course meal into a full five course feast spread across three days:


- **Wednesday, Nov. 25:** Packers at Rams, 8 p.m. ET, Netflix
- **Thursday, Nov. 26:** Bears at Lions, 1 p.m. ET, CBS
- **Thursday, Nov. 26:** Eagles at Cowboys, 4:30 p.m. ET, FOX
- **Thursday, Nov. 26:** Chiefs at Bills, 8:20 p.m. ET, NBC and Peacock
- **Friday, Nov. 27:** Broncos at Steelers, 3 p.m. ET, Prime Video


The Thanksgiving Eve game is new this year, while the NFL plants its flag on Black Friday for the fourth consecutive season. Including[Monday’s matchup between the Cincinnati Bengals and Washington Commanders](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/best-bengals-commanders-cards-joe-burrow-jamarr-chase-jayden-daniels-values) , football fans are absolutely eating this week—and Courtyard's got special packs to add to the feast 👀


## **Barry Sanders vs. Emmitt Smith: Thanksgiving Legends & Rookie Card Values**


The two Hall of Fame running backs overlapped from 1990 to 1998, and football fans got to watch them back-to-back on Thanksgiving for years. Lucky us.


Smith leads all players in career Thanksgiving rushing yards with 1,178, passing the 10,000 career rushing yard mark during the ‘96 Thanksgiving Day game, while Sanders is second with 931 on 210 carries, adding eight touchdowns—and seven wins—across his 10 Thanksgiving Day games for Detroit.


Looking to collect cards from either of the two Hall of Fame running backs? Courtyard’s got you covered.


### **1989 Score #257**[Barry Sanders](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Barry%20Sanders&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 10)**


Sanders’ main rookie card doesn’t feature an auto or a patch, but it’s a timeless classic, just like Sanders himself. A PSA 10 sold for $3,270 at Heritage Auctions in 2021, with more than 2,500 copies grading at a PSA 10—including one that was pulled out of one of[Courtyard’s Football Diamond Packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/football-diamond-pack) during this Thanksgiving Week. It must be a sign.


### **1998 SkyBox Premium Star Rubies #189**[Emmitt Smith](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Emmitt%20Smith&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(BGS 7 NM)**


This isn’t Smith’s first card (or his last), but it sure is a beauty. Pulled out of a[Courtyard Football Mythic Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/sports-legend-pack) earlier in November 2026, the football collector that ripped it is[proudly keeping it in their collection](https://courtyard.io/asset/78001a701fcc1e2802dd5684e1101b93879d7f261db08a026233ca8441b4d5a0?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_fmv_high_to_low) , which happens to contain a serious treasure trove of football cards.


## [Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **vs.**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **: Record-Setting Football Cards & Grails**


The Chiefs visit Buffalo—and their brand new stadium—for the Bills’ first Thanksgiving home game in franchise history. Allen is 5-1 against Mahomes in the regular season. The playoffs are another story; Mahomes is 4-0 against Allen in the postseason, including a number of[heartbreaking wins](https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap/_/gameId/401326633) .


When it comes to Thanksgiving games, the Bills are 6-4-1 all time, and Allen is a perfect 3-0 on Turkey Day, with Mahomes losing his lone Thanksgiving Day game.


We know their record on the field. Now let’s check out their record-setting cards.


### **2017 National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto NFL Shield 1/1**[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card (BGS 8.5)**


Sold privately through PWCC for $4.3 million in July 2021, the most ever paid for a football card at that time.


On Courtyard, a **2017 Panini Donruss Optic #177 Patrick Mahomes II - Autograph-Black Rookie Card (PSA 8 NM-MT) valued at $26,310** awaits in[Courtyard’s Football Legend Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/football-legend-pack) ($2,500), while new Thanksgiving-themed football packs give football card collectors a shot at ripping Mahomes grails—and winning a bounty, too.


### **2018 National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto #163 Platinum NFL Shield 1/1**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 8.5)**


Sold privately through for $1.7 million in August 2026, this card marks the highest price ever paid for an Allen card. Allen, Mahomes and Tom Brady are the only NFL players with two or more $1 million card sales, and there’s plenty of Allen grails on Courtyard, including a **2018 Panini Contenders #105 Josh Allen - Variation-Autograph-Ticket Stub Rookie Card(PSA 10 GEM MINT)** valued at $16,500 found in[Courtyard’s Football Diamond Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/football-mythic-pack) ($1,000). New Thanksgiving-themed football packs on Courtyard feature Allen grails—and Courtyard Point bounties—too.


## **The Turducken and John Madden**


John Madden called 20 Thanksgiving Day games and famously gave a turkey leg to the MVP of each one. However, it wasn’t until Thanksgiving Day in 1996 that he ate[a turducken](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/32698561/the-day-john-madden-met-turducken) , introducing many across the world to the delicacy.


Since Madden’s passing in 2021 (RIP), the NFL has had a John Madden Thanksgiving Celebration at every Thanksgiving Day game since, with the turducken becoming a staple of many a Thanksgiving Day football broadcast.
